About:

Meet Cosmo | Apply Here

Cosmo is a 7-month-old Jindo Mix weighing 20 lbs. Rescued from a farm kennel, this thoughtful, sensitive girl takes her time before she lets you in, but when she does, the trust she gives is quiet, complete, and unwavering. Around her friends she's playful and full of life, and there's something deeply endearing about a dog who holds nothing back. She can't wait to find her forever home in NYC!

You don’t have to wait for an adoption event. In-person meet-and-greets are available in the NYC area, with virtual meet-and-greets available for adopters outside NYC.
